verses.1: And all the tribes of Israel came to David as their leader. They said, “We are you, and your words are our truth.”
verses.2: And even when Shaul was king over us, you were the one who brought Israel back from exile. And God said to you, “You will rule over my people, Israel, and you will be their judge.”
verses.3: And all the elders of Israel came before King Heberon. King David made a covenant with them in front of Jehovah. Then he appointed David as king over Israel.
verses.4: David reigned for thirty years; he ruled for forty years in total.
verses.5: In Jerusalem, he ruled over Judah for seven years and six months. In Jerusalem alone, he ruled over all of Israel and Judah for thirty-three years.
verses.6: And the king and his men went to Jerusalem, to the house of Yahweh, who dwells on the earth. They said to David, “Do not come here. Only when you remove the idols and the priests from there will I allow you to come.” But David refused to go there.
verses.7: David gathered together the people of Zion. Zion is the city of David.
verses.8: And David said on that day, “All those who are strong and brave will be defeated and suffer pain. The Pessach and other festivities will also be ruined. David’s pride will be destroyed. Therefore, they will say, ‘Pessach and Pessah do not come into the house.’”
verses.9: David sat down in his place, and he called it “the city of David”. David built cities around it.
verses.10: And David went forth, and he became great. And the LORD, the God of hosts, was with him.
verses.11: And Heirham, king of Zion, sent servants to David. They brought him cedars, cypress trees, and other kinds of wood. With this wood, they built the house for David.
verses.12: David knew that Jehovah had prepared him to be king over Israel. And it was because of the people of Israel that his mother was taken away from him.
verses.13: And David took more wives and concubines from Jerusalem, after his separation from his wife. And David had sons and daughters.
verses.14: And these are the names of the men who lived in Jerusalem: Shmuel, Shuvav, Nathan, and Shlomo.
verses.15: And Eliezer will be chosen, and he will be injured and suffer.
verses.17: And the Philistines heard that David had become king over Israel. So all the Philistines went up to ask for David’s hand in marriage. David heard this and went down to the battlefield.
verses.18: And the Philistines came and were defeated at the Valley of Rephaim.
verses.19: And David asked the LORD, “Let me go to Philistines and give them over to you.” The LORD said to David, “Go, for I have given you control over those Philistines.”
verses.20: And David came to Baal-Perazim. There, David defeated his enemies. Then David said, “May the Lord defeat my enemies before me, just as the waters are defeated by the sea.” Thus, the name of that place became Baal-Perazim.
verses.21: And they left their sorrows there, and David and his men went away.
verses.22: And the Philistines still gathered together to attack them, but they were defeated at the valley of Rephaim.
verses.23: And David asked Jehovah, “Do not bring the ark to them. Come to them from above, from heaven.”
verses.24: And when you hear the sound of footsteps in the wilderness, then be afraid, for then Jehovah will come before you to attack the camp of the Philistines.
verses.25: And David did as Yahweh commanded him. He drove the Philistines away from Gibeah to Boaz.
